fields.label: Aspect
fields.value: Swift Between Chimes, Helpless in the Silence

fields.label: Capabilities
fields.value: Carries a pilot and three passengers along the tower's resonant airways. Its fabric keel can skim roofs but cannot sustain flight when the bellwind stops.

fields.label: Piloting
fields.value: This setting uses Core's Drive for piloted conveyances. Roll only when opposition or a meaningful hazard makes the outcome uncertain; the skiff has no independent action or skill rating.

fields.label: Useful fittings
fields.value: A folding retrieval hook and a canvas sound-baffle can support create-advantage actions. Neither grants automatic free invokes.

fields.label: Risk / counterplay
fields.value: The thirteenth bell will reverse the main airway. Land before the marked warning chime, take the sheltered maintenance channel, or secure a roofline tow.

fields.label: Ownership
fields.value: Lark lends it for the witness extraction. If vehicle damage becomes central, agree a vehicle-extra model before play rather than inventing HP during the chase.
